---
title: Choose a template
description: Three compositions of the same business code, a monolith, a modular monolith and a service, and what sets them apart.
---

## What they are

`PouryaKit.Templates` holds three [Project templates](/docs/reference/glossary#project-template). Each starts a new application from the [Proving Sample's](/docs/reference/glossary#proving-sample) business code; they differ only in how that code is composed into a [Host](/docs/reference/glossary#host).

<Callout title="The same business code in every template">
  The business code is the Proving Sample's own files in each template. Only the [Composition Root](/docs/reference/glossary#composition-root) and the endpoint adapters differ, so moving from one composition to another leaves the business code as it is: [What each composition composes](/docs/capabilities/templates#what-each-composition-composes).
</Callout>

## When to use each

| Template | Short name | Choose it when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Monolith](/docs/templates/monolith) | `pouryakit-monolith` | You start with one [Module](/docs/reference/glossary#module) and no need for Modularity yet |
| [Modular monolith](/docs/templates/modular-monolith) | `pouryakit-modular-monolith` | You have, or soon will have, several Modules in one Host |
| [Service](/docs/templates/service) | `pouryakit-service` | One Module runs in a Host of its own and receives another Host's [Integration Events](/docs/reference/glossary#integration-event) and [Snapshots](/docs/reference/glossary#snapshot) over RabbitMQ |

[Template choice](/docs/decision-guides/template-choice) walks through the questions that decide it.

## Install and generate

<Steps>
<Step>

### Install the template package

<include lang="bash" meta='title="Terminal"'>../get-started/install-templates.sh</include>

</Step>
<Step>

### Generate the one you chose

```bash title="Terminal"
dotnet new pouryakit-monolith -n Acme.Shop
dotnet new pouryakit-modular-monolith -n Acme.Shop
dotnet new pouryakit-service -n Acme.Stock
```

</Step>
</Steps>

## What every template holds

| | Stated in |
| --- | --- |
| The Host's composition and [startup checks](/docs/reference/glossary#startup-check), the same in each | [What each composition composes](/docs/capabilities/templates#what-each-composition-composes) |
| A smoke test that hosts the generated Host against PostgreSQL in a container | [The smoke test](/docs/capabilities/templates#the-smoke-test) |
| The service defaults recipes, as the application's own code | [The optional recipes](/docs/capabilities/templates#the-optional-recipes) |
| Every Kit package pinned at the template package's version | [Install and generate](/docs/capabilities/templates#install-and-generate) |
